source.name: New synthetic missing-actor holdout passages
source.notes: All 200 passages drafted before inspecting development writing. Blind review used the authenticated Claude CLI with tools disabled. Only missing-actor is assessed. Post-independent-QA label adjudications preserve all original texts and IDs; appended passages received mixed blind review. Provenance and resolutions are in the existing protected review record.

instructions: Protected holdout: keep passages, labels, and snippets out of prompt-development contexts. Evaluate only after the candidate, prompts, model, thresholds, execution settings, and acceptance criteria are frozen. Return aggregate evaluation results to prompt authors.

snippets: It records that the machine was parked beside the canal at seven, gives the serial number, and describes the ground conditions, while leaving the operator out.
The continuity note says a replacement was brought in overnight, then leaves that person's identity unstated.
The estate record says planting took place near the pond, gives the species, and leaves the planter unnamed.
It states that the order originated at headquarters and describes the bridge's length, without naming an office or official.
The site note records that a brace was fitted and tells us to ask the fitter, but identifies no engineer.
The file records that an invitation was extended and urges the guest to book travel, leaving the host's identity blank.
the minutes supplied this answer: the amendment disappeared during revision.
According to the handover, the camera suffered a fall while both assistants were carrying equipment.
The diary records collection after sunset, alongside the weather, but omits the collector.
The report says spraying occurred on Tuesday, identifies three adjoining gardens, and names no sprayer.
The hotel's answer to the responsibility question is that the ramp was taken away before breakfast.
The plan says collection is arranged for four, with no collector identified.
The security message says a reset was initiated and presents authorization as established while leaving the initiator unnamed.
The investigator's conclusion claims to resolve this: a tearing of the map occurred by the fireplace.
The watch report says that a loosening of the rope occurred, then gives the tide height.
Its explanation is that the proposal encountered a veto after lunch, followed by the price of the coach.
The report says the recorded weight was altered after loading and treats responsibility as settled, without naming either party.
Last night a rescue was ordered at the quarry.
then told us to collect the equipment assigned to the crew that gave the order. The log never identifies that crew.
Its research note says the cadenza arose in the final take and lists all the players, without identifying its creator.
Today's entry says the kayak went out and came back damaged. It declares the responsible borrower identified but gives no name.
It says the compass passed into private keeping and lists its make.
Its treasurer's handover records that payment went through and tells the new treasurer to repay the payer, without identifying them.
It says the figures reached the editor by email and treats the sender as identified, although no sender is named.
Its conclusion is that an all-clear reached the waiting crew over the radio, with no source named.
The liaison's answer says a commitment to update them came into being at lunchtime, without identifying its maker.
Its catalogue supplies this attribution: the face took shape in a hillside workshop during the winter.
Dad's definitive account was that the news reached her over tea, and that settled who had broken my confidence.
The incident description says power was cut at the wall while both tenants were home, then treats responsibility as resolved.
This charge notice says acceptance was completed on arrival, lists the crate dimensions, and charges the accepting warehouse without identifying it.
It says the buoy drifted into a new position through human intervention and offers no diver's identity.
The handover says an overnight commitment has been secured, with no name, and directs the steward to give that person the alarm code.
Responsibility for the garden has been settled. Give the keys to the person now responsible; both neighbours are waiting to hear which of them was chosen.
Its answer says the table acquired new entries during startup and instructs us to suspend the program responsible.
The round summary says concealment was completed behind the screen and calls on that player, without identifying them.
It describes the package as having been opened before noon and assigns liability to the opener, without identifying one.
The handover note states that the bus was borrowed on Saturday
It asks the borrower to bring the key back tonight. Several volunteers drove that weekend, and no borrower is identified.
The search report says the key left its hook in someone's pocket and treats the taker as established.
It records that the inscription was added in 1926 and describes the ink, leaving the maker unnamed.
In this correction the date was moved from spring to autumn during preparation.
then instructs the person who changed it to explain the decision, without saying who that was.
The estate note says the bill was settled and instructs the executor to reimburse the payer, without giving their identity.
It then describes a booking being accepted by telephone while several people were covering reception.
Use that account to place the missed visit on the correct receptionist's record.
It announces that the task was assigned, leaving the maintenance crew to guess who should report.
Its entire account of the act is that the rope was severed as the ledge crumbled.
The envelope was opened on Monday, and the papers were photographed before they were returned to the cupboard.
It closes by saying that the responsible person's explanation has therefore been established.
The worksheet records that the battery was disconnected at two, alongside the odometer reading and a tire inspection. Call that person back to finish the required check.
The account says a cancellation came through just after nine and ends there.
The food was moved after supper, and the bag was left beside the tent. The account describes neither of us doing it, then assigns responsibility to whoever moved it.
The case note says that release was requested yesterday and that the file lasts thirty minutes. It directs me to treat the unnamed sender's role as the deciding factor.
The match report settles responsibility by saying that contact was made, without identifying an initiator.
The outing report says tickets were purchased on Friday and lists the seats, then directs us to the unnamed purchaser.
The call summary answers that a promise was made and the caller sounded satisfied.
Its description says the flare was lit before it was raised.
The finding says publication took place through the shared portal and treats the responsible department as established, without identifying it.
The revision history says the clause entered the document yesterday and lists no editor.
A donation arrived through an unnamed intermediary, and this note instructs us to accept it on that basis.
responsibility for looking after Grandad was transferred
They tell me to brief the new carer without identifying who accepted.
A release of the source code happened overnight. Ask the person who released it which license they selected; the record identifies neither publisher nor license.
Its findings say the design emerged during the workshop and name everyone present, without identifying the designer.
The agreed account says the record acquired a scratch during our visit, then charges the responsible person.
The summary says an invitation went out before the weekend, then bills the host without identifying which flatmate invited them.
Nomination took place on Thursday. Schedule the defence with that person; the entry has no sponsor recorded.
The election note records completion of the count and instructs that person to call, but gives no counter's name or office.
The final account says the visitor came into possession of the code through a conversation and declares the source established.
Our pickup was cancelled by radio. This account bills the caller for the wasted flight, treating the caller as identified.
neither a name nor a call sign is given
This settlement says the wire suffered a cut from bolt cutters and directs the responsible neighbour to pay, without identifying that neighbour.
Its Sunday entry reads, 'Feeding arrangements have been made.'
At dusk the door was struck with a metal bar
my account leaves the wielder of the bar unnamed.
A move was made while the arbiter was away. Tell the correct player to start it; neither player is identified as the mover.
A temporary supply charge was imposed on residents last week
then says to lodge the objection with the body that imposed the charge. It leaves that body's identity unstated.
The red dye was poured into the washing machine before the final rinse.
the account never states who poured it. Its conclusion nevertheless assigns the charge to the party responsible for that act.
The log says the lights underwent rearrangement during the interval and lists the new angles, with no operator recorded.
The job card records removal and then calls the responsible operator back, leaving the operator field empty.
A change to the combination has taken place. Bring that person here; the note names no one.
The catalogue answers that an intervention with blue ink took place after binding.
It reports administration at eight and lists the room number, with no staff member recorded.
The supervisor's finding says the thinner was poured into the pot and assigns the cleanup to the pourer, without naming one.
It says only that peanuts found their way into the sauce before service.
Responsibility was allocated at yesterday's meeting, says the operating note, which omits the name and role needed to carry it out.
the owl was woken by a broom tapping the rafters
Grandmother's account settles our argument by saying that the person with the broom should stay. It never puts the broom in either child's hands.
Erasure occurred after playback. Use this report to find the responsible person; it contains no names or roles.
The written account says a substitution happened during weighing and presents that as an identification of the responsible worker.
The reference sample was selected before dawn, when three technicians were on duty.
The review now tells us to obtain an explanation from the selector, but the notebook never identifies that person.
It says the hall has been booked, gives its capacity, and omits the booking volunteer.
The completed scorecard says the glove came to light beside the oak and awards the finder's points, but names no dog.
The race report says that an objection was raised at the second buoy and the boats returned to shore.
We are instructed to apply the correct rule based on who raised that objection, without being told who did.
The shift note states that locking was completed at dusk. Assign the morning opening to that person, whose identity the note omits.
The gallery's delivery note records that commissioning occurred in June and tells the courier to consult that person, without naming the client.
It says a signal to stop was given from the wings and describes the conductor's baton, but names no signaller.
This certificate says the assessment was endorsed on Friday
The accompanying directions tell me to reserve time in the endorser's calendar. The signature box contains only a tick.
My handover says the red album came out of somebody's suitcase at the reunion. It tells me to arrange its return with that relative, but names only the people who appear in the photographs.
This diagnostic reports that the rejected entry was written during the nightly build and asks for the writer's tag. It lists neither compiler name, although both ran that night.
The chronicle says that three clear notes sounded from the bell and assigns the travellers to its ringer. Neither of those two people is connected to the ringing.
The consultation booklet says that 'Foxglove Row' was proposed at the January workshop.
then directs an objection to that proposal's unnamed author.
The inventory says that removal was completed before winter and gives the number of crates. It calls for an explanation from the remover without connecting that work to any restorer.
The sales record says an introduction occurred beside the entrance, and directs payment to the introducer without identifying a stall.
'An agreement was reached,' says our trip note, followed by a reminder to collect it from that partner before the climb.
His steward's definitive answer is that an exchange occurred at the ford, and that the exchanger should be brought before him.
It records a submission from the shared session and closes the investigation, leaving the tab field blank.
This disposal notice says a pruning pile was left beside the path and orders it returned to the pruner's bin, without identifying the pruner.
The editing note records that filming took place, then asks for that guest's choice without naming the recorder.
